notes.type_correctness: DASState interface, exported constants, and all method signatures match the spec exactly. TouchInput.getHeldActions(deltaMs) signature aligned correctly. TypeScript compilation clean.
notes.pattern_adherence: DAS_KEYS set, OPPOSITE_KEY map, dasStates Map all follow established patterns in keyboard.ts. The accumulator-based timing is idiomatic. One minor deviation: arrAccumulator carries leftover time after DAS trigger (correct — prevents ARR jitter) rather than resetting to 0 as spec implied, but this is the right behavior.
notes.test_coverage: All 7 spec-required test groups (A–G) implemented with 16 tests total. DAS boundary, ARR cadence, reset on release, opposite-key cancellation, and SoftDrop regression all covered. Edge case: 200ms single-call scenario (DAS + immediate ARR overflow) tested explicitly.
notes.security: Pure keyboard event handling with no network I/O, no eval, no DOM injection. No security surface introduced.
notes.architectural_alignment: Layer boundaries respected: keyboard.ts imports only from engine/types.js. DAS_MS and ARR_MS exported as named constants (not magic numbers). getHeldActions receives deltaMs from the caller — no internal clock reads, preserving pure/deterministic property.
